title: Verified users tab
changes: The Users page has tabs above the list: All users, ✅ Verified email (accounts that confirmed their email) and Not verified, each with a count.
After resetting a password, logging someone out or changing a role, you stay on the same tab.

title: User counters
changes: The Users page now starts with three counters: Online now (guests + signed-in people in the last 10 minutes), Logged in & active (plus how many were active today), and Registered accounts (plus new today and this week).
The site now remembers when each account was last active, to power these counters.

title: Previous / next buttons in the reader bar
changes: The reader's top bar (the one that hides while scrolling and comes back when you scroll up or double-tap on phones) now has ‹ › buttons for the previous and next chapter.
They're greyed out on the first chapter or when the next one isn't out yet.

title: New table of contents
changes: Every novel page now shows “Latest release”: the 5 newest chapters with their position (#861) and how long ago they came out.
Below it, all chapters are grouped by 250 (Chapters 1 - 250, 251 - 500, …) in sections that open with a tap.
Each section loads only when opened, so novels with thousands of chapters load fast.
The section with the chapter a reader got to opens automatically, with read chapters greyed out and the last one marked ▶.

title: Scroll to the next chapter
changes: At the end of a chapter (below the comments) a “Keep scrolling for the next chapter” card shows the next chapter's title with a progress bar.
Scrolling on down to the bottom opens the next chapter as a normal new page, starting at the top (not an endless page), so every chapter is a fresh page for ads.
It only happens when the reader deliberately scrolls past the end; reloading at the bottom, or typing a comment, never jumps.
Readers can switch it off in Reader settings (“Scroll past the end to open the next chapter”); the setting is saved to their account.

title: Editable About page
changes: Site settings now has an “About us page” section: change the page title, all of its text, and the description Google shows.
The text box starts with the current About text, so you can edit it instead of starting from scratch. Clear it and save to go back to the built-in text.
Simple formatting: ## for headings, - for bullet points, **bold**, *italic* and [links](https://…).
Automatic values like {novels} and {chapters} fill in the current numbers.

title: Hidden novels stay on Google
changes: Hidden novels are only hidden on the site: guests don't see them on the home page, browse, genres or search.
Google still sees them: they're back in the sitemaps and RSS feed, and search engines are notified of new chapters.
Anyone with a link (for example from a Google search) can read a hidden novel, with the usual 10 free chapters for guests.

title: Novels hidden by default
changes: All novels are now hidden from guests and search engines by default; only signed-in accounts can see them. New novels start hidden too.
Choose which novels everyone may see under Site settings → Public novels (or with the 👁 Make public button on the Novels page).
The home page shows today's reading activity for everyone: readers today, chapters read today and chapters read in total (counting every novel, hidden ones too).
Guests see a “Most of our library is for members” box with sign-up and log-in buttons.

title: Members-only novels
changes: New 🔒 Hide button on the Novels page (and a Members only switch in each novel's Details): hidden novels can only be seen and read by signed-in accounts.
Guests and search engines don't see hidden novels anywhere: home page, browse, search, sitemaps, RSS feed and profiles.
Guests who open a hidden novel's link are asked to log in or sign up, and come back to the same page afterwards.
Press 👁 Make public to show a novel to everyone again.

title: Server storage
changes: Update & backup now shows the server's disk: free space, total size, and how much this site uses, with a warning when it gets full.
A breakdown of the site's space: database, cover images, backups, code.
List of backups kept on the server, with a button to delete old ones (the 3 newest are always kept).
Memory (RAM) use of the server and the site.

title: Bigger batch uploads
changes: Batch upload now accepts .zip/.epub files with up to 10,000 chapters (was 5,000), up to 600 MB unpacked.
You can also pick up to 10,000 chapter files at once.

title: Daily leaderboard and 10 free chapters
changes: New 🏆 Daily leaderboard in the admin panel: novels ranked by that day's views, with change from the day before, rank movement and unique readers. Browse earlier days with the arrows or date picker.
The dashboard shows today's top 5 novels.
Guests can now read 10 chapters before being asked to sign up (was 40). Change it any time under Anti-scraping.
Chapter splitting understands raw headings like 第一百二十章, 第12話 and 제12화.

title: Update history
changes: Update & backup now keeps a log of every update: its release date and its main changes.
Before installing, you see what's new in plain words instead of technical notes.
Each update in the log shows when it was installed on your site.

title: Automatic titles and scrolling menus
changes: 🏆 Top Reader: given automatically to the top 10% of registered readers by chapters read today (India time); resets at midnight IST.
📜 Ancient Reader: given automatically to every account created before 1 December 2026.
The admin panel's left menu scrolls on its own on short screens and phones; Log out stays visible.
The phone menu and account menu on the site scroll instead of running off the screen.

title: Supporter role and titles
changes: New Supporter role: a reader who sees no ads. Set it under Users.
Admins and translators no longer see ads (avoids accidental clicks on your own ads).
New Titles page: create badges with an icon, name and colour and give them to people. They're just for show.
Role and title badges appear next to names in comments, reviews and profiles.

title: Stronger anti-scraping
changes: Browser check: chapter text only loads in real browsers, so simple scrapers get nothing.
AI training bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot…) are blocked.
Daily chapter cap for accounts, chapter speed limit, and blocking of IP addresses.
New Anti-scraping page in the admin panel with a master on/off switch and a switch for each protection.

title: Ads and Contact page
changes: AdSense ad units on the home page, novel pages and chapter ends, plus one gentle in-article ad inside long chapters.
New Contact page, with messages arriving in the admin panel's Messages inbox.
Heavens Devour The Worthy by Fenz Sly added, marked as an original work (no translator).
